title: Learning When Human Decisions Matter: Executor-Relative Consultation Value for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.05814v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models increasingly automate complex tasks, but human decision capacity does not scale with their capabilities. In many applications, humans remain essential for providing private context, authority, or judgments unavailable to the agent. We formulate human decision capacity allocation: given multiple consultation opportunities and a limited budget, at which decisions should an LLM agent consult a human? The central challenge is estimating consultation value, which is executor-dependent because the same human input may benefit different downstream agents differently. We introduce Consultation Value Distillation (CVD), which estimates consultation values offline using Monte Carlo executor rollouts and distills these values into lightweight predictors for budgeted allocation, requiring no rollout-based value estimation at deployment. translated_title: 学习何时人类决策至关重要：面向大语言模型智能体的执行者相对咨询价值
translated_abstract: 大语言模型日益自动化复杂任务，但人类的决策能力并不会随着模型能力的提升而扩展。在许多应用中，人类在提供私有背景信息、权威性或智能体无法获取的判断方面仍然不可或缺。我们提出了人类决策能力分配这一形式化问题：在存在多个咨询机会且预算有限的情况下，大语言模型智能体应该在哪些决策上咨询人类？其核心挑战在于估计咨询价值，而咨询价值依赖于执行者，因为同样的人类输入可能对不同的下游智能体产生不同的收益。我们提出了咨询价值蒸馏方法，该方法利用蒙特卡洛执行者模拟离线估计咨询价值，并将这些价值蒸馏到轻量级预测器中用于预算受限的分配，在部署时无需进行基于模拟的价值估计。在五个批量设置和三个序贯设置以及两个前沿执行器上，CVD 提升了……
tldr: 该论文提出咨询价值蒸馏方法，通过蒙特卡洛执行者模拟离线估计依赖执行者的人类咨询价值并蒸馏为轻量级预测器，使LLM智能体能够在有限人类决策预算下智能地决定何时咨询人类。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Consultation Value Distillation (CVD), which estimates executor-relative human consultation values offline via Monte Carlo executor rollouts and distills them into lightweight predictors, enabling LLM agents to intelligently decide when to consult humans under a limited human decision budget.
